case_title: MELITON CABRERA CARBAJAL VS. JOSE VIDAL

docket_entries.description: REQUEST THAT CLERK ENTER JUDGMENT ON FINAL ORDER, DECISION OR AWARD OF THE LABOR COMMISSIONER FILED BY PLAINTIFF CARBAJAL, MELITON CABRERA AS TO DEFENDANT VIDAL, JOSE AN INDIVIDUAL DBA PRO LINE PAINTING JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED

UNDER APPLICATION TO THE CLERK FOR JUDGMENT UNDER SEC 585(1) C.C.P., IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CARBAJAL, MELITON CABRERA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VIDAL, JOSE AN INDIVIDUAL DBA PRO LINE PAINTING $5,255.18 PRINCIPAL, $134.03 INTEREST, $180.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,569.21, SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
